# Zhao 2017
dat <- read.table('/Users/jessica/Documents/UCSF Winter 2026/EPI 217/GCST004894.tsv', header=TRUE, sep="\t", check.names=FALSE)
clean_dat <- dat %>%
  rename(P = `P-VALUE`, 
         CHR = CHR_ID, 
         BP = CHR_POS, 
         SNP = SNPS,
         GENE = `REPORTED GENE(S)`) %>%
  mutate(CHR = as.numeric(as.character(CHR)),
         BP = as.numeric(as.character(BP)),
         P = as.numeric(as.character(P)))
manhattan(clean_dat, 
          main = " Manhattan Plot: Zhao et al. (T2D)", 
          col = c("orange", "darkblue"), 
          highlight = "rs2237892",
          suggestiveline = FALSE, 
          genomewideline = -log10(5e-08))

qq(clean_dat$P, main = "Q-Q Plot of T2D GWAS")

kcnq1_info <- clean_dat %>%
  filter(grepl("KCNQ1", GENE)) %>%
  select(SNP, GENE, P)

kcnq1_info
##         SNP  GENE     P
## 1  rs231362 KCNQ1 4e-09
## 2  rs231362 KCNQ1 2e-11
## 3 rs2237892 KCNQ1 2e-63
## 4 rs2237892 KCNQ1 1e-09
# table
table_data <- clean_dat %>%
  arrange(P) %>%
  distinct(GENE, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  head(5) %>%
  select(SNP, CHR, GENE, P, `OR or BETA`) %>%
  mutate(
    BETA = as.numeric(`OR or BETA`),
    OR = exp(BETA),
    P_fmt = formatC(P, format = "e", digits = 1)
  ) %>%
  select(SNP, CHR, GENE, P_fmt, BETA, OR)

table <- table_data %>%
  mutate(
    BETA = round(BETA, 3),
    OR = round(OR, 2)
  ) %>%
  kbl(
    col.names = c("SNP (rsID)", "Chr", "Locus/Gene", "P-value", "Beta (β)", "Odds Ratio"),
    caption = "Table 1: Top Susceptibility Loci for T2D",
    align = "c",
    booktabs = TRUE
  ) %>%
  kable_classic(full_width = F, html_font = "Cambria") %>%
   row_spec(0, bold = T)
table

# Spracklen 2020
dat2 <- read.table('/Users/jessica/Documents/UCSF Winter 2026/EPI 217/GCST010118.tsv', header=TRUE, sep="\t", check.names=FALSE)

spracklen <- dat2 %>%
  rename(P = `P-VALUE`, 
         CHR = CHR_ID, 
         BP = CHR_POS, 
         SNP = SNPS,
         GENE = `REPORTED GENE(S)`,
         OR = `OR or BETA`) %>%
  mutate(CHR = as.numeric(as.character(CHR)),
         BP = as.numeric(as.character(BP)),
         P = as.numeric(as.character(P))) %>%
  filter(!is.na(CHR) & !is.na(BP) & !is.na(P)) %>%
  arrange(CHR, BP)

snps_to_highlight <- spracklen$SNP[grep("rs2237892", spracklen$SNP)]

manhattan(spracklen, 
          col = c("orange", "blue"), 
          highlight = "rs2237897",
          suggestiveline = FALSE, 
          genomewideline = -log10(5e-08),
          chrlabs = as.character(sort(unique(spracklen$CHR))),
          ylim = c(0, 260))

qq(spracklen$P) 

# Find the SNP associated with KCNQ1 in this specific file
kcnq1_snp_info <- spracklen %>%
  filter(grepl("KCNQ1", GENE)) %>%
  select(SNP, GENE, P)

kcnq1_snp_info
##         SNP  GENE      P
## 1 rs2237897 KCNQ1 2e-245
# KCNQ1 SNP to highlight in plot
kcnq1_lead <- spracklen %>% 
  filter(grepl("KCNQ1", GENE)) %>% 
  arrange(P) %>% 
  head(1)
target_snp <- kcnq1_lead$SNP
table_2020 <- spracklen %>%
  arrange(P) %>%
  distinct(GENE, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  head(10) %>%
  select(SNP, CHR, GENE, P, OR) %>%
  mutate(P = formatC(P, format = "e", digits = 1),
         OR = round(OR, 2))

table_2020 %>%
  kbl(col.names = c("SNP (rsID)", "Chr", "Locus/Gene", "P-value", "Odds Ratio (OR)"),
      caption = "Table 1: Top Loci for Type 2 Diabetes (Spracklen et al., 2020)",
      booktabs = TRUE, align = "c") %>%
  kable_classic(full_width = F, html_font = "Cambria") %>%
  row_spec(which(table_2020$GENE == "KCNQ1"), bold = T, background = "#F2F2F2") %>% 
  footnote(general = "Source: GWAS Catalog GCST010118", 
           general_title = " ",
           footnote_as_chunk = T)
